description.en:
Adds several characters, one after the other, to the party with the recruitment presentation. For each character, the jingle J_08 plays, the system message "sysmes-add_party" is shown with the character's name filled in (CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_CHARA), then the character is added with AddParty. The next character waits until the jingle has finished.
The BGM is left playing: no fade and no extra wait.
It is a preset of AddParty_MessageEx(_add_num, _aParamID, _aPtLock, _aAvatarEnable, _aAvatarLock, _aLv, -1, -1, "J_08", 0, "sysmes-add_party").
Number of characters to add; the arrays below are read from index 0 to _add_num - 1.
Parameter IDs of the characters, e.g. ["para_cp0001", "para_cp0013"].
One level per character; -1 (or any value of 0 or less) keeps the current level.
